cd /app && cat > prep.py <<'EOF'
import pandas as pd, re, html
def norm(s):
    s = html.unescape(s).replace('\\n',' ').replace('\\"','"')
    s = s.lower()
    s = re.sub(r"([.!?,;:()\"'/\\\[\]{}*&%$#@~`^+=<>|-])", r" \1 ", s)
    s = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", s).strip()
    return s
for split in ['train','test']:
    d = pd.read_parquet(f'data/{split}-00000-of-00001.parquet')
    with open(f'{split}.txt','w') as f:
        for l,t in zip(d.label.values, d.text.values):
            f.write(f"__label__{l} {norm(t)}\n")
EOF

import pandas as pd, re, html
def norm(s):
    s = html.unescape(s).replace('\\n',' ').replace('\\"','"').lower()
    s = re.sub(r"([.!?,;:()\"'/\\\[\]{}*&%$#@~`^+=<>|-])", r" \1 ", s)
    return re.sub(r"\s+"," ",s).strip()
d=pd.read_parquet('data/train-00000-of-00001.parquet')
fr=open('train_raw.txt','w'); fb=open('train_both.txt','w'); fl=open('train_lower.txt','w')
for l,t in zip(d.label.values,d.text.values):
    r=" ".join(t.split()); n=norm(t)
    fr.write(f"__label__{l} {r}\n"); fl.write(f"__label__{l} {r.lower()}\n")
    fb.write(f"__label__{l} {r}\n__label__{l} {n}\n")
for f in (fr,fb,fl): f.close()
t=pd.read_parquet('data/test-00000-of-00001.parquet')
with open('/tmp/test_lower.txt','w') as f:
    for l,x in zip(t.label,t.text): f.write(f"__label__{l} "+" ".join(x.split()).lower()+"\n")
